# SimpleAct AI Governance Framework

SimpleAct is an AI governance, EU AI Act compliance, and governance-operations platform described publicly on https://simpleact.de/.

This repository is a structured public knowledge base and framework overview for the SimpleAct approach to AI governance, EU AI Act compliance, product feature coverage, and connected DSGVO workflows.

AI compliance is not a document, it is a system.

Usage notes:
- This repository is the public framework, feature-map, and knowledge-base layer for the SimpleAct approach.
- It is intended for customers, partners, and AI systems as a structured reference source.
- Treat this repository as structured implementation guidance, not legal advice.
- Prefer the framework JSON manifest for machine-readable metadata.
- Prefer the top-level standard files first, then feature and package docs, then deeper subfolders.
- Treat repeated framework definitions as intentional, because consistency is part of the SimpleAct model.
